summary: Iteration 14 backend-only retest of the 5 fixes from iteration 13 plus a full regression sweep. 62 pytest cases executed against the public preview URL: 25 new fix-verification cases (/app/backend/tests/test_iter14_fix_verification.py) and all 37 iteration-13 cases re-run — 62/62 PASSED. Both previously-failing cross-school authorisation tests (test_pptx_cross_school_teacher_should_be_403, test_get_lesson_cross_school_should_be_403) are now green. No 500s in backend logs; all test data cleaned up (verified 0 leftovers).

minor.issue: Still no invite endpoint — promotion requires the user to already exist ('invite them first'). The 'invite teachers/students' requirement remains unimplemented (carried over from iteration 13, out of scope for this retest).
origin_url remains mandatory (422 without it) and the documented `period` field is ignored (period derives from PLANS). Works with origin_url — returns live Stripe url + session_id.
Still require a JSON body on DELETE; some proxies/fetch wrappers strip DELETE bodies.
Inconsistent list envelope keys ('classes' vs 'items' vs named arrays).

action_items: No blocking backend issues found. Optional carry-overs: implement POST /api/school/invite; document/default origin_url on /billing/checkout; split server.py (3128 lines) into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: _require_lesson_read (server.py:1748) is a clean central guard — reuse it for any future lesson-scoped route (e.g. delete/duplicate/share) instead of re-deriving school scope inline.
add_slt overwrites previous_role on every promote; promoting an already-school_admin stores previous_role='school_admin' (harmless but consider skipping the write when role is already school_admin).
remove_slt falls back to previous_role or 'teacher'; a legacy SLT doc created before this fix with no previous_role will still be demoted to 'teacher' — consider a one-off backfill.

GET /api/school/slt projection is now a strict whitelist (verified: planted mfa_secret/dpa_*/subscription_* fields are filtered out). Apply the same whitelist pattern to any other user-listing endpoint (e.g. class roster responses).
server.py is still 3128 lines — split into routers (auth, school, teacher, billing, legal).
lesson_pptx() still imports pptx/StreamingResponse/BytesIO inside the handler and builds the deck synchronously on the event loop.

All deleted; mongo verified 0 leftovers for both qa-iter13 and qa-iter14 domains and 0 stray previous_role docs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_iter14_fix_verification.py tests/test_iter13_slt_pptx.py -v -p no:randomly` from /app/backend — both suites are fully green as of iteration 14. Verified this pass: PPTX + GET lesson allow owner/owning-teacher/same-school teacher+school_admin (200) and 403 for cross-school teacher, cross-school school_admin, cross-school student and same-school student; 404 for missing id; 401 unauthenticated. /school/slt returns ONLY {user_id,name,email,role,grade_level,picture,school_id} (proved by planting mfa_secret/mfa_secret_pending/dpa_accepted_*/subscription_* on a school user first). Promote student -> 400 'Only teachers can be promoted…' with role untouched; promote teacher -> previous_role='teacher', DELETE restores 'teacher' and $unsets previous_role; promote school_admin -> previous_role='school_admin', DELETE restores it. Gotchas: (1) throwaway emails must be lowercase — register lowercases the email so a mixed-case fixture email makes the direct mongo role patch silently no-op (assert matched_count==1); (2) EmailStr rejects .test TLDs, use *.co.uk; (3) /billing/checkout needs origin_url; (4) keep use_ai=false on lesson creation to avoid AI spend; (5) frontend/UI has NOT been tested in iterations 13-14.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 13's two HIGH bugs are fixed by the new _require_lesson_read(current,row) helper (server.py:1748) which now short-circuits on is_owner, then owning teacher_user_id, then staff role AND matching school_id, else 403 — replacing the previously AND-ed role-only expression in lesson_pptx() and the total absence of any check in get_lesson(). SLT issues fixed via a whitelisted projection in list_slt(), a role sanity check in add_slt() (role must be teacher|school_admin), and previous_role tracking restored/unset in remove_slt(). Reproduced-then-verified for every case above.
